sfx.prompt: Inside a modern passenger train carriage travelling at steady cruising speed. Constant deep rolling rumble, gentle rhythmic clatter of wheels over rail joints, smooth air-conditioning hum, an occasional soft interior creak. Even, calm, continuous interior ambience.

Inside a passenger train carriage travelling through a long tunnel. Loud deep booming roar with dense reverberation, rushing air pressure, wheel clatter echoing off concrete walls. Continuous and steady.
Inside a passenger train carriage crossing a long steel viaduct. Hollow metallic resonance under the wheels, open airy tone, crisp rhythmic clacking. Continuous and steady.
Steady airflow rushing against a train window at speed. Smooth broadband wind hiss with slow gentle swells. Continuous.
A sudden muffled whoosh and a soft pressure thump as a train enters a tunnel, heard from inside the carriage.
A quick release of air pressure and a whoosh opening into wide outdoor space as a train leaves a tunnel, heard from inside the carriage.
A distant two-tone train horn echoing across a wide mountain valley, with a long natural reverb tail.
A warm two-note chime played on a small brass bell: a gentle attack and a long clean ringing decay.
A single low chime note from a small brass bell, warm and round, with a long gentle decay.
Brief analog radio tuning: a short burst of static with a quick frequency sweep.
